decision_contract.research_question: Does latest_1m_close_position_prev5_range show enough descriptive separation between YM observations that do and do not experience the existing prevailing 1-minute regime transition within 300 seconds to justify expanding the TRAIN sample?
decision_contract.primary_comparison: Descriptive distribution and directional breakdown of latest_1m_close_position_prev5_range against the canonical flip target, on YM 2024-09-03 RTH only.
decision_contract.terminal_question: What are the empirical distribution and target relationships of latest_1m_close_position_prev5_range on YM RTH 2024-09-03, and is a one-day TRAIN sample sufficient descriptive evidence to justify expanding the TRAIN sample?
